transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot know true IFR, transmissibility, or geographic spread without mass testing and genomic sequencing — every other decision depends on this data.

actions.rationale: We cannot know true IFR, transmissibility, or geographic spread without mass testing and genomic sequencing — every other decision depends on this data.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from confirmed source regions buys critical weeks to slow additional seeding while domestic data is still being gathered.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from confirmed source regions buys critical weeks to slow additional seeding while domestic data is still being gathered.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: PPE, test kits, and ventilator supply chains take weeks to scale — invoking the DPA now prevents the shortages that would otherwise arrive exactly when the outbreak peaks.

actions.rationale: PPE, test kits, and ventilator supply chains take weeks to scale — invoking the DPA now prevents the shortages that would otherwise arrive exactly when the outbreak peaks.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Transparent, data-driven daily briefings build public trust, coordinate voluntary behavior change, and reduce the rumor-driven panic that harms markets more than honest uncertainty does.

actions.rationale: Transparent, data-driven daily briefings build public trust, coordinate voluntary behavior change, and reduce the rumor-driven panic that harms markets more than honest uncertainty does.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A real-time national data dashboard lets states, businesses, and citizens see the same facts and make calibrated decisions, reducing both under- and over-reaction.

actions.rationale: A real-time national data dashboard lets states, businesses, and citizens see the same facts and make calibrated decisions, reducing both under- and over-reaction.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Emergency funding and expanded statutory authority will be needed within days — engaging Congress now prevents the legislative lag that crippled past crisis responses.

actions.rationale: Emergency funding and expanded statutory authority will be needed within days — engaging Congress now prevents the legislative lag that crippled past crisis responses.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens. Roughly 2 more deaths reported this week.

SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 2.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 57/100. Hospital strain 15/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: With R=1.8 and a severity range spanning catastrophic, a crash vaccine program must start now — every week of delay on a 12-18 month development timeline directly costs lives at the back end.

actions.rationale: With R=1.8 and a severity range spanning catastrophic, a crash vaccine program must start now — every week of delay on a 12-18 month development timeline directly costs lives at the back end.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, high-impact intervention that can meaningfully reduce R without economic damage, and establishing the norm now is far easier than mandating it during a crisis peak.

actions.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, high-impact intervention that can meaningfully reduce R without economic damage, and establishing the norm now is far easier than mandating it during a crisis peak.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Targeted shielding of the elderly and high-risk buys critical time before broader restrictions may be needed, and is the highest-value intervention when severity data are still uncertain.

actions.rationale: Targeted shielding of the elderly and high-risk buys critical time before broader restrictions may be needed, and is the highest-value intervention when severity data are still uncertain.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Passing relief while the economy sits at 99 is far easier than after a crash — it stabilizes household and small-business confidence and gives us fiscal credibility for harder measures ahead.

actions.rationale: Passing relief while the economy sits at 99 is far easier than after a crash — it stabilizes household and small-business confidence and gives us fiscal credibility for harder measures ahead.
